status: Approved Decision 4. Neither view is the definitive business truth. The distinct view is a sensitivity scenario.

original_rows.definition: All PR PO source rows, unchanged.
original_rows.limitation: If repeated rows are copies of one document line, counts, quantities and amounts are overstated.

exact_distinct_rows.definition: First occurrence of each group of rows identical in all 18 source columns.
exact_distinct_rows.limitation: If repeated rows are real separate transactions, counts, quantities and amounts are understated. This is a sensitivity scenario, not a correction of the data.

data_label: Source data documented as synthetic (dummy) in the Data Context & Relationship Diagram; not operational performance.
